text:
Anya: Heads up — candidate for Backend IC3 moved their slot from 11:00 PST -> 14:00 PST today due to travel. Can someone cover the 14:00 panel? We also need a scribe + confirm recording consent.

Mike L: I can swap but I have a call 14:15-14:45. If we can shift the panel to 14:45 I can take it, otherwise I need cover. :grimacing:

Samir: I can pick up the 14:00 panel and scribe if needed. Have access to the recording link. Do we want me to use the usual debrief template?

Anya: Thanks Samir — yes please use the usual debrief. Quick note on rubric: product/communication vs coding weight changed slightly this req. Kelly, can you post the score weights and 2 example anchors we want people to use today?

Kelly: Yep — for this role: coding 55%, system design 25%, collaboration/communication 20%. Two anchors: 
1) "Strong" coding (5): writes clean, tests edge cases, explains tradeoffs quickly.
2) "Borderline" coding (3): solves core case but misses edge cases and needs prodding.

Samir: Helpful, thanks. One clarification: for system design, do we score "architecture" and "scalability" separately or as a single design score?

Kelly: Single design score. In the debrief template, add a short line: "Design notes: key tradeoffs considered (max 3)" — that helps normalization across panels.

Mike L: If Samir is scribing, I can cover the 14:45 slot after my call. Samir, if you want me to hop into the last 10 min for Qs, I can.

Samir: That works. I'll scribe and capture sample prompts and approximate times. Can someone confirm camera/recording consent? I don't want to record without candidate agreement.

Anya: Candidate confirmed they consented via scheduling form. Add that to the debrief: "candidate consent: yes (scheduling form)". Also, use this quick schedule snippet in the calendar invite if you're editing: 

```
14:00 - 14:30 Technical coding (interviewer: Samir)
14:30 - 14:55 System design (interviewer: Mike L)
14:55 - 15:05 Debrief (panel)
```

Anya: Interview kit / debrief template: https://redwood.ai/interview-kit (please use the "IC3 + coding-heavy" version).

interview-bot: Calendar updated: event "Backend IC3 - candidate (rescheduled)" moved to 14:45-15:35 by Anya. Recording flag: on. Notes appended: "candidate consent: yes".

Mike L: :thumbsup: thanks — I'll join at 14:35 to catch the design section if Samir needs the handoff.

Samir: Perfect. I'll fill out the debrief immediately after and tag @Kelly for normalization if scores look off.

Anya: Appreciate the quick swap everyone. If anything changes ping here and I'll resend the invite. :sparkles:
